scope: Proposed acceptance gates for the full owner PLY1 reconstruction, fixed from source spacing before inspecting the reconstructed mesh. These are engineering scan-fidelity criteria, not a statement of physical scanner accuracy.
distanceUnits: Source coordinate units; ScanForge treats imported coordinates as millimeters, but file units are not independently certified.
rationale: At least 95 percent of each complete directional sample set must remain within two measured source sample intervals; at least 99 percent within four. Maximum and RMS remain mandatory diagnostics. Filling an unsupported open region is counted as reverse-distance error, not silently excluded.
limitations: The original PLY is a measured exchange reference, not physical ground truth.
These gates use complete vertex and centroid sample sets rather than a continuous symmetric Hausdorff bound.
Original defects do not excuse output defects without a localized measured correspondence.
Output components and boundary edges must be reported; closure versus density trimming depends on explicitly selected settings.
Normal agreement is reported against the retained scanner normals without a posthoc angular acceptance threshold.
